inductance.ja_description: コイル STEP -> L_coil (vacuum) または L_coil + ΔL (weak-coupled).  --coil-solver peec | bem-a で切替。--vol 指定で workpiece 弱結合 (Telegen φ・B back-reaction)。
inductance.method: PEEC perimeter filaments OR BEM-A Weggler EFIE saddle (RWG); workpiece scalar BIE + SIBC Robin

params.name: coil_step

params.name: coil_solver
params.help: peec: PEEC perimeter filaments from STEP (fast). bem-a: Weggler EFIE on RWG, reads pre-meshed .vol.

params.name: peec_proximity
params.help: Use proximity-aware iterative PEEC (default ON; augments the Bessel self-skin Zs_fil with the Leontovich surface dissipation evaluated from the actual Biot-Savart H field at each filament's wire-surface position).  Pass --no-peec-proximity to fall back to the isolated-wire Bessel self-skin only.

params.name: peec_proximity_max_iter
params.help: Maximum proximity outer iterations.  On the 3-turn pancake at 150 kHz the iteration exhibits a transient hump near iter 30 then settles by iter 50 (relax=0.3).  Default 60 gives ~10 iter margin.

params.name: peec_proximity_relax
params.help: Proximity outer-iteration under-relaxation factor (0 < relax <= 1; 0.3 is conservative).

params.name: coil_maxh
params.help: DEPRECATED (kept for back-compat); BEM-A now reads pre-meshed --coil-vol instead of re-meshing CAD on-the-fly.

params.name: coil_source_name
params.help: Coil source-cap face name (bem-a; falls back to area-based detection if absent)

params.name: coil_sink_name
params.help: Coil sink-cap face name (bem-a; same fallback)

params.name: coil_aca_eps
params.help: HACApK ACA eps for coil (bem-a, future)

params.name: coil_gmres_tol
params.help: HACApK GMRES tol for coil (bem-a, future)

params.name: coil_saddle_solver
params.help: Saddle-point solver for the BEM-A impedance-EFIE: auto (LU below 5000 tris for AC / 10000 for frequency=0; above that cocr), lu (dense LAPACK, overwrite_a=True), cocr (SCALABLE: div-free loop reduction + complex-symmetric COCR, ~24 mesh-independent iters, exact vs LU, dense SL matvec -- the recommended large-N solver), hacapk_cocr (the same COCR with the HACApKBEMManager-compressed O(N log N) SL matvec, accuracy ~3e-7, RT0 only; identical R/L), gmres (complex-capable Krylov -- unpreconditioned, stalls on large saddles), minres (REAL symmetric Krylov -- VALID ONLY for the frequency=0 vacuum-L solve; scipy MINRES assumes a Hermitian operator and silently returns a wrong solution on the complex-symmetric AC saddle, so it is rejected there). Defaults to auto.

params.name: esim_relax
params.help: Karl under-relaxation (0,1]; 1.0 = full step, 0.5 = half-step (default, matches calc_fem_kelvin).  Lower if Karl oscillates near saturation.

params.name: esim_per_panel
params.help: Per-DOF ESIM Karl iteration (Phase B): the ESIM cell solver is called once per BEM DOF using a per-node H_t extracted from the phi_vec, building a per-node Z_s ndarray instead of a single scalar.  Resolves the spatial saturation pattern; costs N_DOF extra ESIM calls per Karl iter (~5 ms each).  Requires --wp-bem-backend intree-dense.

params.name: esim_anderson_m
params.help: Anderson-acceleration memory depth for the outer Karl iteration.  0 (default) = plain damped Picard.  3-5 closes the per-DOF dZ_max noise floor when --esim-per-panel is used.  See src/radia/esim_anderson.py.

params.name: h1_order
params.help: Workpiece BEM Lagrange basis order (NOT the geometry curving order, which is auto-detected from the .vol's companion .vol.json -- the .vol's curvedelements is fixed at Cubit-export time and a post-load mesh.Curve(p) silently falls back to flat). 1 = P1 hat (flat-friendly default).  2 = Lagrange-P2 (uses curved Tri6 geometry if the .vol has curve order >= 2, otherwise P2 basis on flat Tri3 geometry).

streamfunction.ja_name: ストリーム関数コイル設計
streamfunction.ja_description: コイル面 .vol + 評価領域 .vol + 目標磁場 (CoefficientFunction 式; スカラー→Bz / 3成分→ベクトルB) から表面電流ストリーム関数 ψ を設計。design (均一度・最大電流密度) / pareto (フロント α掃引) / manufacture (一筆書き+板金+STEP+PEEC) の3モード。
streamfunction.method: FE-direct H1 psi on a surface .vol + surface Biot-Savart + folded-Tikhonov (ACA+TSVD RegularizedTSVD)

params.name: eval_vol
params.help: evaluation region mesh (.vol; surface or volume)

params.name: target_cf
params.help: target field CoefficientFunction expr of x,y,z (scalar -> Bz; 3-vector -> B). Give this OR --target-harmonic.

params.name: target_harmonic
params.help: target as a spherical harmonic (MRI gradient/shim basis, l<=4): a name (Z0,X,Y,Z,Z2,ZX,ZY,C2,S2,Z3,Z2X,..,Z4,Z3X,Z2C2,ZC3,C4,..) or 'l=L,m=M', optionally weighted/summed, e.g. 'Z2', 'X' (Gx), 'Z2:1.0,Z:0.1'. Generates the solid-harmonic --target-cf polynomial.

params.name: harmonic_lmax
params.help: max degree l for the achieved-Bz spherical-harmonic decomposition (purity/contamination; l<=4). 0 = off.

params.name: order
params.physics: メッシュ高次要素次数 (1-5)

params.name: regularize
params.help: seminorm: l2 (min |psi|), h1 (min |grad psi|, a smoothness proxy), or inductance (min 1/2 psi^T L psi -- the physical MIN-STORED-ENERGY gradient-coil objective via ngsolve.bem; dense, moderate N)

params.name: confine
params.help: current-confinement BC. off=none; on=psi 0 on the former edge (gradient/shim; breaks solenoids); abe=Abe edge-equipotential (one free constant per boundary + ground) -- closes the contours AND works for gradient and solenoid (recommended).

params.name: pareto_lever
params.help: front-pushing lever: alpha (Tikhonov L-curve), linf (minimax IRLS peak-current trajectory), geometry (eval-region scale sweep)

params.name: geom_scale_min
params.help: geometry lever: eval-region scale lower bound

params.name: geom_scale_max
params.help: geometry lever: eval-region scale upper bound

params.name: optimize_levels
params.help: manufacture: optimise the N contour LEVELS (vs the uniform equal-deltaI default) to minimise the equal-current discrete-loop field error -- the few-turn quantisation fix (keeps clean contours; complements --distort's wire bend).

params.name: greedy_turns
params.help: LOW-TURN STRATEGY (manufacture): build the coil GREEDILY -- lay up to this many turns one at a time, each placed where it most reduces the field residual (matching pursuit, monotone by construction; the antidote to non-monotonic contour quantisation).  Emits the rms-vs-turns trace (read off the fewest turns meeting any spec).

params.name: greedy_dict
params.help: greedy candidate loops: 'contour' = dense psi iso-contour loops (A); 'pin' = on-surface k-ring loops at surface pins (B, 'wind a loop on a pin'); 'bubble' = bubble-packed pins, density ~ |grad psi| (C).

params.name: greedy_connector_weight
params.help: connector-aware greedy: bias selection toward loops NEAR the ones already laid (score = field_residual + weight * gap/coil_diag) so the single-stroke connector ('rung') path stays short -> manufacturable wire.  0 = pure-field (default); ~0.3-1.0 trades a little field for short rungs (fixes the isolated-pin chaining penalty).

params.name: greedy_target
params.help: greedy stop threshold: stop adding turns once the field residual rms <= this (else use all --greedy-turns).

params.name: greedy_plot
params.help: turn-budget UI: write the greedy rms-vs-turns curve (with the --greedy-target spec line + min-turns mark) to this PNG.

params.name: pin_tiling
params.help: DENSE BUBBLE-TILING pin coil (manufacture, many-turn): equal-current loops packed over the surface with density ~ |K| = |grad psi| and sized to their bubble -- the discrete-loop, manufacturable alternative to long iso-contours (dense where the current is strong).

params.name: pin_tiling_pins
params.help: pin-tiling / bubble greedy dict: target number of bubble loops (k is bisected to land ~this many).

params.name: pin_tiling_frac
params.help: pin-tiling / bubble greedy dict: loop radius as a fraction of the bubble clearance radius (0.7 -> loops tile without heavy overlap).

params.name: target_inductance
params.help: IH-RESONANCE design: search the turn count (nlevels) so the single-stroke coil inductance equals this value in Henries (the field design is unchanged; L_coil ~ N^2 sets the resonance).  Forces --peec.  WITH --greedy-turns: turns are fixed by greedy (the low-turn coil), so nlevels is NOT searched; instead the result reports required_cap_F (the tank capacitor to resonate the delivered coil at --peec-freq).

params.name: resonance_cap
params.help: IH-RESONANCE design via the tank capacitor in Farads: target L = 1/((2 pi f)^2 C) with f = --peec-freq (the inverter frequency).  Alternative to --target-inductance.  WITH --greedy-turns: turns are fixed by greedy, so the result reports the resonance frequency THIS coil + this cap reach (resonance_freq_Hz) plus required_cap_F to hit --peec-freq exactly.

params.name: nlevels_max
params.help: upper bound for the IH-resonance nlevels search

params.name: contour_sub
params.help: order-p contour: subdivide each surface triangle sub x sub and evaluate the full-order psi (sub=1 = vertex-linear; sub=3 follows the curved order-2/3 psi within each element) (manufacture)

params.name: chain
params.help: single-stroke chaining: field_aware (min net connector field; reaches the separate-turns floor for closed contours, no distort) or nn (nearest neighbour)

params.name: chain_ncut
params.help: field_aware cut candidates per loop (0 = auto-scale with loop count; raise for clustered/many-loop coils)

params.name: chain_passes
params.help: field_aware cut coordinate-descent rounds (0 = auto-scale with loop count)

params.name: step_output
params.help: STEP CAD output path for the wire (manufacture)

params.name: former_output
params.help: printable FORMER STEP (manufacture): a base plate with the DELIVERED wire CHANNEL cut out (plate - swept tube), for water-soluble-support 3D printing -- dissolve the support to leave the out-of-surface groove the single-stroke wire threads through. Distinct from --step-output (the wire centreline). STEP coords in metres; scale in the slicer.

params.name: former_clearance
params.help: former channel radial clearance in m (channel radius = wire-diam/2 + clearance; default 0.3 mm)

params.name: former_margin
params.help: former plate XY margin beyond the wire footprint in m (default 5 mm)

params.name: former_wall
params.help: former minimum wall thickness around the channel in m (sets the plate Z half-thickness beyond the wire z-extent; default 3 mm)

params.name: former_decimate
params.help: former channel spine resample step in m (coarsens the wire polyline to bound the CAD primitive count / build time; 0 = no decimation; default 2.5 mm)

params.name: former_stl
params.help: printable FORMER as STL via a ROBUST MESH boolean (trimesh + manifold3d) -- the recommended path: it handles the 3D self-crossing single-stroke wire that the OCCT STEP route (--former-output) segfaults / under-cuts on, in ~1 s and watertight, and STL is the native 3D-print format. Same --former-clearance/-margin/-wall/-decimate knobs. Needs: pip install trimesh manifold3d. STL coords in metres; scale in the slicer.

params.name: peec
params.help: compute PEEC coil inductance L, R (manufacture)

params.name: wire_diam
params.help: PEEC wire cross-section size in m (manufacture)

params.name: flux_plot
params.help: bubble-system flux-line PNG of the coil field on a cut-plane (manufacture)

params.name: steps_plot
params.help: per-step manufacturing PNG (contours -> single-stroke -> sheet-metal -> with thickness) (manufacture)

params.name: scan_map
params.help: MEASUREMENT TWIN (manufacture): 3-component (Bx,By,Bz) planar raster scan of the delivered single-stroke wire -- the simulation counterpart of a 3-axis magnetometer (TMR/fluxgate) scan. Emits Bnormal (main uniform field), Bt (in-plane transverse leakage from single-stroke connectors -- what a 1-axis probe misses), homogeneity, and saves the full grid to a JSON to compare against a measured +-I current-reversal scan.

params.name: scan_plane
params.help: scan-plane normal axis (default z: an x-y plane above a planar coil). Bnormal is the component along this axis.

params.name: scan_standoff
params.help: scan-plane offset (m) along the normal from the coil centroid = the sensor standoff height. Default: the eval-region (DSV) height, so the scan sits where the design targets uniformity.

params.name: scan_half
params.help: scan half-width (m) in the two in-plane axes (square grid). Default: the eval-region in-plane half-extent (the DSV footprint).

params.name: scan_n
params.help: scan raster points per axis (n x n grid; default 21)

params.name: scan_current
params.help: physical drive current (A) the map is scaled to (field is linear in current). Default: the best-fit design current. Set the bench current to match the sensor reading directly.

params.name: scan_output
params.help: JSON path for the full 3-component scan grid. Default: next to --output (<base>_scanmap.json).

params.name: iron_vol
params.help: iron/material .vol (iron region + 'kelvin' ball + periodic kelvin_int/kelvin_ext + 'GND' vertex -- the calc_fem_kelvin pipeline). When given, the design is MATERIAL-AWARE: the iron reaction (reduced scalar potential, Kelvin open boundary) is ADDED to the free-space kernel so a coil designed near a yoke/shield/core hits the target IN the iron system. Free-space by default (omit this flag).

params.name: mu_r
params.help: relative permeability of the --iron-vol iron region (linear; default 1000).
params.physics: mu = mu_0 * mu_r

params.name: iron_mat
params.help: material name of the iron region in --iron-vol (default 'iron').

params.name: iron_exact_source
params.help: material-aware kernel: evaluate the coil source field at the iron QUADRATURE points (analytic Biot-Savart, no P1-vertex interpolation -> removes the source plateau, ~14%% on a coarse shell).  Much heavier (one assembly per quad point); opt-in.  Default is the fast P1-vertex source.

params.name: shield_vol
params.help: outer shield coil surface mesh (.vol). When given, designs a PRIMARY + SHIELD coil jointly (Turner 1986 method): the shield cancels the stray field outside --shield-eval-vol while primary + shield together produce the target field inside --eval-vol (DSV). Only 'design' mode; requires --shield-eval-vol.

params.name: shield_eval_vol
params.help: external evaluation region (.vol) WHERE THE STRAY FIELD MUST VANISH (used only with --shield-vol). Typically a thin shell just outside the shield cylinder.

params.name: shield_weight
params.help: weight on the stray-field null-constraint rows relative to the DSV target rows (default 1.0). Increase to push stray suppression; decrease if DSV homogeneity degrades too much.

params.name: msh_output
params.help: optional GMSH .msh of psi on the coil surface
params.physics: 場の可視化用 .msh v4.1

params.name: output
params.ja: 出力 JSON ファイル

motor_transient.ja_description: モータ .vol から、非線形 FE + 回路 ODE 連成で過渡応答を解く。PM 回転と Arkkio トルクを含む。radia_motor パネルの 'Transient' モード。
motor_transient.method: Nonlinear FE (A-formulation) + circuit ODE co-simulation, PM rotation, Arkkio torque (Lange-Henrotte-Hameyer 2009)

params.name: vol
params.physics: Netgen Vol 形式。材料・境界ラベル・高次要素を含む

params.name: linear_solver
params.help: FE direct solver. pardiso=MKL (fastest, default); sparsecholesky=ngsolve built-in (no MKL) -- use on machines with a conflicting MKL on PATH (e.g. CST).

params.name: L_endwinding
params.help: H, lumped end-winding inductance per phase

params.name: pm_Br_value
params.help: T, PM remanence on rotor_pm region (0 = no PMs)

motor_lamination.ja_name: 積層鉄心 等価材料 (Hollaus)
motor_lamination.ja_description: 積層鉄心の 1D セル問題で等価材料テーブルを構築し (cell)、それを .vol 上の global FE に適用 (global/full)。radia_motor パネルの 'Lamination' モード。
motor_lamination.method: Hollaus effective-material homogenization (1D cell problem) + global HCurl FE with the effective-material table

params.name: mode
params.help: cell=offline cell problem only, global=use existing em-table on .vol, full=cell+global in one run

params.name: sigma
params.physics: 材料の電気伝導率。銅: 5.8e7, 鉄: 2e6 [S/m]

params.name: drive
params.help: cell driving: meanB (canonical Hollaus 2024), current (Hanser 2025 J_s), voltage (planned)

params.name: J_s_iron
params.help: A/m^2, uniform current density in iron (drive='current' only)
